title: Crab Derby, 2006 · after
logline: The Monday after: the flyer on the wall and a woman with a dark braid reading it from the dock, her hand on the rail, and Gully behind the counter not looking out the window with his whole body. Wood on the stool drawing the not-looking.

panels.composition: Through the window: a woman with a dark braid on the dock reading the new flyer on the wall.

characters.pose: reading the flyer, from the dock

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, through a shop window a woman with a dark braid on a dock reading a flyer pinned to a shingle wall

panels.composition: GULLY behind the counter with his back to the window, rigid, wiping a clean cup.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a stocky man in an apron with his back to a window wiping a cup that is already clean

panels.composition: WOOD on the stool with the pad, drawing Gully's back.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a thin man on a stool drawing a stocky man's rigid back on a pad

panels.composition: The pad: Gully's back, the cup, and above it, tiny, the window with the braid in it.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a pad showing a drawing of a man's back and a cup with a tiny window above containing a woman with a braid
